description: React component for rendering a channel view in Mattermost, including post display, header, overlays, and conditional UI for archived or restricted channels.

classes.name: ChannelView
classes.description: React component managing the display and interaction of a Mattermost channel, including post rendering, header, overlays, and conditional messages for archived or restricted channels.

methods.name: createDeferredPostView
methods.description: Creates a deferred component rendering for PostView with accessibility attributes.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Static lifecycle method to update component state based on new props, especially URL and focused post ID.

methods.name: onClickCloseChannel
methods.description: Handles closing the channel view by navigating to the last viewed channel.

methods.name: onUpdateInputShowLoader
methods.description: Updates the loader state based on input activity.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to update WebSocket active channel and fetch restrictions when props change.
